test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: According to the Press Information Bureau release on 2ⁿd February 2022, which of the following sites has NOT been identified for the Saffron Bowl project in Meghalaya?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tura.**__

__
 
• According to the Press Information Bureau release on 2nd February 2022, sites that has been identified for the Saffron Bowl project in Meghalaya is **Shillong, Barapani and Cherrapunji.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• ​North East Centre for Technology Application and Reach (NECTAR) under **Saffron Bowl project** has identified few locations in Arunachal Pradesh and Meghalaya for saffron cultivation.
 
• In Meghalaya, sample plantations were grown at **Cherrapunji, Mawsmai and Lalingtop sites**.
 
• The total cost of the whole project is **Rs. 17.68 **lakhs for Arunachal Pradesh and Meghalaya. 
 
• Out of which, a tentative amount of **Rs.6.00 l**akhs has been earmarked for Barapani (Meghalaya) site.
 
• This information was given by Minister of State (Independent Charge) of the Ministry of Science and Technology and Earth Sciences, **Dr. Jitendra Singh **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Conrad Kongkal Sangma** is the Chief minister of Meghalaya.
 
• Capital of Meghalaya is **Shillong.**
 
• **Shri.** Satyendra Prakash** IIS **is the chairman of Press Information Bureau.
